resources.name: Li₄Ti₅O₁₂ spinel crystal structure (CIF)

access.notes: Also available from ICSD #170354 or COD 2102174; any standard CIF for the cubic spinel Fd‑3m structure is acceptable.

resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open‑source plane‑wave DFT package. The agent may use an equivalent (ABINIT, GPAW, …); the checker only inspects the final CSV outputs.

resources.notes: Used for geometry optimisation, DOS, and NEB calculations.

resources.name: PAW pseudopotentials (PBE, SSSP or equivalent)

access.notes: Pseudopotentials for Li, Ti, O, Mg, Zr from a consistent library (SSSP efficiency or GBRV).

resources.notes: Required for DFT calculations; the agent should choose appropriate pseudopotentials.
